title: Fix the parity compatibility gate so legacy entries with no Excel/PDF export (fixed reports, financial statements, field completeness) can reach parity-passed
description: Stage 2 parity defect: ReportMigrationRegistry.CompatibilityDeclared requires ExcelCompatible || PdfCompatible. 18 manifest entries are declared ExcelCompatible=false, PdfCompatible=false because their legacy routes expose only JSON/tables (the 10 fixed ReportController GET endpoints report:product-sales-ranking/order-profit/customer-shipment/salesman-output/sales-commission/container-stats/follow-up-due/quotation-conversion/inventory-movement/inventory-aging; the 7 financial statements report:balance-sheet/income-statement/cash-flow/ar-aging/purchase-cost/tax-refund-summary/stock-alert; and export:product-export-field-completeness). These entries therefore always fail CompatibilityDeclared and are permanently stuck at preset-ready — they can never reach parity-passed even with complete four-dimension evidence, which contradicts the stage-2 requirement to migrate ALL fixed and financial reports to parity. Fix the parity derivation so an entry declaring no legacy Excel/PDF (both false) is a valid declaration (vacuous Excel/PDF compatibility, since the generic platform adds Excel/PDF as a superset), preserving fail-closed behavior and never deriving parity-passed without the four-dimension comparison evidence. No new controller/designer/exporter, no arbitrary SQL, no schema/seed/migration changes, no secrets/env, no permission expansion; only the registry parity logic plus regression tests. Not audit-only: it makes fixed-report and financial-statement parity actually reachable.
acceptance_criteria: ReportMigrationRegistry parity derivation treats an entry declared ExcelCompatible=false and PdfCompatible=false as a valid compatibility declaration (vacuous — no legacy Excel/PDF to preserve), so fixed-report and financial-statement entries are no longer permanently stuck at preset-ready and advance to parity-passed when the four-dimension evidence is complete.

Entries declaring at least one Excel/PDF capability keep existing behavior (dynamic reports, bill-export families, packet, documents), and no entry reaches parity-passed without complete four-dimension evidence (fail closed).

Add/update executable unit coverage asserting a fixed report (e.g. report:product-sales-ranking or report:balance-sheet) reaches parity-passed with complete evidence, that a false/false entry without evidence stays preset-ready, and that existing dynamic/export parity tests keep passing. Run the related tests plus the safe Release build/unit suite and scheduler self-test/contracts.
implementation_evidence: src/ERP.Application/Services/ReportMigrationRegistry.cs:218-219 CompatibilityDeclared(definition) => definition.ExcelCompatible || definition.PdfCompatible, and :111-112 gates parity-passed behind !CompatibilityDeclared(definition) -> PresetReady. src/ERP.Application/DTOs/ReportMigrationRegistryDtos.cs:129-158 declares all 10 fixed reports with '..., false, false)'; :161-181 declares the 7 financial statements with '..., false, false)'; :245-247 declares export:product-export-field-completeness with '..., false, false)'. The ReportController fixed endpoints (ReportController.cs:84-389) expose only JSON ApiResponse (no Excel/PDF routes), so false,false is the correct legacy declaration and must not block parity-passed.
